title: Detecting Misbehaviors of Large Vision-Language Models by Evidential Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2602.05535v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: %Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown substantial advances in multimodal understanding and generation. However, when presented with incompetent or adversarial inputs, they frequently produce unreliable or even harmful content, such as fact hallucinations or dangerous instructions. This misalignment with human expectations, referred to as \emph{misbehaviors} of LVLMs, raises serious concerns for deployment in critical applications. These misbehaviors are found to stem from epistemic uncertainty, specifically either conflicting internal knowledge or the absence of supporting information. However, existing uncertainty quantification methods, which typically capture only overall epistemic uncertainty, have shown limited effectiveness in identifying such issues. translated_title: 基于证据不确定性量化的大型视觉-语言模型不当行为检测
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解与生成方面取得了显著进展。然而，当面对能力不足或对抗性的输入时，它们经常产生不可靠甚至有害的内容，例如事实幻觉或危险指令。这种与人类期望的不一致，被称为LVLMs的“不当行为”，对其在关键应用中的部署引发了严重的担忧。研究发现这些不当行为源于认知不确定性，具体表现为内部知识冲突或支持信息的缺失。然而，现有的不确定性量化方法通常只能捕捉整体的认知不确定性，在识别此类问题方面效果有限。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了证据不确定性量化（EUQ），这是一种细粒度的方法，能够同时捕捉信息冲突与无知，从而有效检测……
tldr: 提出了一种细粒度的证据不确定性量化方法（EUQ），通过同时捕捉知识冲突与信息缺失这两类认知不确定性，有效检测大型视觉-语言模型的不当行为。
